paragraphs: Niche runs a school search site covering K-12 schools, colleges and graduate schools for students and families. The site carries profiles on every school and college in America along with ratings, reviews and search tools. The about page also states that the company connects people to schools and neighborhoods.

Direct Admissions is described as a form of college admissions in which colleges proactively offer acceptance to students they know they would admit. Offers rest on a student profile rather than an application, and each participating college or university sets its own criteria for acceptance and scholarships. The pages state that Niche has official partnerships with the colleges carrying the Niche Direct Admissions icon.
On the school side, the homepage asks college and K-12 school representatives to partner with Niche to connect with students and families. That page states that over 1,700 schools partner with Niche.

quote.text: Niche connects people to their future schools and neighborhoods.
